title: Goals: set company goals and track their progress

s01.narration: Hi, I'm Maria from the Sloneek team. Today we'll set up the Goals module, create a company goal with a subgoal, and look at how to check progress.

s02.narration: Let's start with the settings. At the bottom of the left menu, I'll click Goal settings.

s03.narration: First, I choose how often owners should check their goals. I'll switch to monthly.

s04.narration: Settings save automatically. Below, I can see when the check-up reminder goes out. For monthly, for example, it's the second day of the month at nine in the morning.

s05.narration: On the right, I set the default visibility: company goals are visible to the whole company, team goals to the whole team.

s06.narration: And who can create goals. I'll leave company goals to admins only.

s07.narration: Now to the goals themselves. Under Company, I'll open Goals.

s08.narration: I can see all company goals with their level, progress, status and due date. To create a new one, I click New goal.

s09.narration: I'll call it Increase customer satisfaction to ninety percent.

s10.narration: I'll keep the level at company and choose Kristýna Nová as the owner.

s11.narration: I'll set the priority to high.

s12.narration: I'll set the due date to the end of the year.

s13.narration: Under Metrics, I'll choose numerical: starting value eighty-two, target ninety, and the unit is percentage.

s14.narration: I'll turn on regular check-ups and save the goal.

s15.narration: Let me open the goal detail.

s16.narration: A big goal is easier to reach in smaller steps. I'll click New subgoal.

s17.narration: I'll call it Launch a monthly satisfaction survey. The parent goal is already filled in.

s18.narration: The owner will be Kristýna again, and the due date the end of November.

s19.narration: As the metric, I'll choose Checklist and add two tasks: prepare the questionnaire and send it to customers.

s20.narration: I'll save it, and the subgoal appears in the goal detail.

s21.narration: Back in the overview, I can group goals, for example by owner.

s22.narration: And I'll switch to the tree view, where I see the whole hierarchy: our goal together with its subgoal.

s23.narration: The goal owner finds it under My goals. They only see goals they own, created, or follow.

s24.narration: When it's time for a check-up, they get a task in My tasks, on the Goal checkups tab.

s25.narration: But they can update progress at any time, right in the goal detail.

s26.narration: Under Options, I'll choose Update progress.

s27.narration: I'll enter the current value, eighty-five, set the status to On track, and confirm.

s28.narration: The progress has been recalculated, and the activity log keeps a record of the check-up.

s29.narration: And that's it. You now know how to set up Goals, create a goal with a subgoal, and update its progress. Tip: you can also create goals from Performance evaluation.

s30.narration: If something doesn't work, check the Help Center. Less admin, more time for people. This is Sloneek.
